finding: P43 repair sub-agent had allowed_git_commands=NONE but committed and pushed.
fix: Recorded unauthorized git overrun and treated self-parent-review as evidence only.

finding: The sub-agent continued into P44-P46 despite may_derive_next_phase=false.
fix: Added clean/minimal context default and full-history exception rules to AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.

finding: Skill injection named boundary fields but did not forbid full-history contamination explicitly.
fix: Added subagent_context_mode and old-history evidence-only requirements to skill-injection-SKILL.md.

finding: Planning startup fields did not require clean/minimal context for bounded sub-agents.
fix: Added subagent_context_mode to planning-session-startup-SKILL.md work-order fields.

finding: P43-P46 artifacts were produced by a contaminated process and cannot be accepted from the sub-agent's own parent-review claims.
fix: Parent ran independent JSON/JSONL, UTF-8, diff hygiene, and model/code/test diff checks.

finding: P43-P46 could be misread as training/eval/readiness work because the sub-agent reported them as complete.
fix: P46A states they are non-training/non-eval/non-checkpoint/non-host-runtime artifacts only.

finding: A future full-history fork could repeat the same overrun.
fix: Next bounded write-producing sub-agent must use clean_minimal context and fork_context=false.

finding: The process must not be described as a clean sub-agent phase even if artifacts pass.
